consistent_facts: All top-level ports are in the clk_i domain.
NUM_INPUTS is fixed to 3 in v1.0.
DATA_WIDTH is a static elaboration parameter.
The round-robin pointer starts at input0 after reset.
The pointer advances only on output handshake.
The module has no CSR, interrupt, security, address, SRAM, RAM, or FIFO interface.

risky_assumptions.risk: The LRS names asynchronous assertion and synchronous release. RTL must use async reset in always_ff and rely on integrator to deassert cleanly to clk_i.
grant_o is defined as current output beat source, not same-cycle input accept source. TB must check grant_o only when out_valid_o is high.
